paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of examples and the minADE20 value for two different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Examples” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “minADE20 ( )” and displays a linear scale from 15.0 to 18.0, with tick labels at 0.5 intervals. A blue line, labeled “ST-ES”, is present, marked with circular data points, and begins at approximately 17.1 at an x-value of 0. The line declines steadily to a value of approximately 15.4 at an x-value of 2, and then remains relatively constant, fluctuating between approximately 15.4 and 15.6 for the remainder of the x-axis range, ending at approximately 15.6 at an x-value of 8. An orange line, labeled “Random”, also marked with circular data points, starts at approximately 17.8 at an x-value of 0, decreasing to approximately 17.1 at an x-value of 2, continuing to approximately 16.9 at an x-value of 4, then increasing slightly to approximately 17.0 at an x-value of 8.
